_comment: Viewport presets used by the harness. Width/height are CSS pixels. deviceScaleFactor controls retina capture (2 = 2x bitmap output for crisp screenshots; 1 = 1:1). The defaults below are tuned for product UI: mobile is iPhone 14 Pro, tablet is iPad Pro 11", desktop is the most common laptop size in 2025 analytics, wide is for dashboard / monitor layouts. Override by passing --viewport-config <path-to-this-file> to the harness, or extend by adding new keys.

mobile.description: iPhone 14 Pro logical resolution. Use as the default mobile target.

mobile-small.description: Smaller Android footprint. Good for testing tight layouts.

mobile-320.description: WCAG SC 1.4.10 Reflow target. Content must work at this width.

desktop.description: Most common laptop viewport in 2024-2025 analytics. Default desktop target.

desktop-13.description: 13" laptop. Useful for catching mid-breakpoint issues.

wide.description: External monitor. Tests upper-bound layout behavior.

ultrawide.description: Use only when designing explicitly for ultrawide.
